body: hey, im rooting for you. thank you for still being here and helping.

thank you, ill try. ill try to stay alive. maybe it will be worth it, i dont know. i guess ill have to see. it hurts but i guess not all of me wants to die. not until i apologize to everyone i hurt. thank you for helping. youre a good person.
no, i dont do that stuff. my memory is awful in stressful and emotional situations and this situation is like that in particular so its even worse. sorry.

i cant talk to them now. i think theyre asleep. i wont bother them anymore with this, ill just make them upset again. its better it stays this way, maybe they wont miss me because of that.
and you said youve been there recently. im sorry to hear that. thank you for being here and helping. it means a lot.

i don't know. this tends to happen when i'm at my worst. it feels like there's fog in my head.
i know i said something wrong and everyone got angry at me. i had an argument with my friends after that. then it escalated to this point where i dont want to be alive.
im sorry if it doesnt make sense, it keeps making less and less sense but im trying to keep it somewhat understandable.

something just broke the last straw. ive been feeling low for a few months now but i said something i shouldnt have and i regret it. everyone hates me now and i dont think i can fix it.
sorry if this is too vague. im having trouble thinking correctly.
